title: 第一卷 第16章 以弱胜强，低调夺宝
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
树丛之后，苏玄尘静静观望。

    神色平淡，不起波澜。

    秘境之内，弱肉强食，本就是常态。

    没有实力，再好的机缘也守不住。

    那两名弟子太过软弱，被夺资源，在所难免。

    他本打算绕行，不争无谓纷争。

    可下一瞬，为首黑衣弟子的一句话，让他脚步顿住。

    “快点采摘！这片月华草全部收好。”

    “听说那百岁老头也进秘境了，咱们运气好。”

    “等摘完药草，顺路去找找那老家伙。”

    “一个炼气二层的老朽，身上肯定带着宗门赏赐的好东西。”

    “咱们四人联手，直接抢了他的资源！顺便教训一下这个占尽风头的老东西！”

    其余三人立刻附和。

    “好主意！”

    “整个外门都看他不顺眼，早就想收拾他了！”

    “极品天灵根又如何？修为垃圾、肉身垃圾，还不是任我们拿捏！”

    四人语气嚣张，肆无忌惮。

    显然，他们早就盯上了苏玄尘。

    想借着秘境无人管束的机会，欺凌老者、掠夺资源、博取名声。

    若是能打压这位宗门重点培养的“百岁天才”，回到外门，绝对能一战成名。

    树丛后方，苏玄尘眼底掠过一丝微凉。

    本想安稳寻宝，低调发育。

    奈何总有人主动上门找麻烦。

    既然如此，那就别怪他出手无情。

    苏玄尘不再隐藏，缓步走出树丛。

    白发随风微拂，身形佝偻，气息平平。

    看上去，依旧是那副风烛残年、孱弱可欺的模样。
content_en:
Behind the trees, Su Xuanchen watched quietly.

    His expression was calm and unremarkable.

    In the secret realm, the law of the jungle is the norm.

    Without strength, no matter how good the opportunity is, you can't hold on.

    Those two disciples were too weak and it was inevitable that they would be deprived of their resources.

    He had planned to go around and avoid any unnecessary disputes.

    But the next moment, the words of the leading disciple in black stopped him in his tracks.

    "Hurry up and pick! Gather all the moonflower grass."

    "I heard that the hundred-year-old man also entered the secret realm. We are lucky."

    "After picking the herbs, I'll look for the old guy along the way."

    "An old man on the second level of Qi Refining must have good things on his body that were rewarded by the sect."

    "The four of us joined forces to directly steal his resources! By the way, we will teach this old guy who hogs the limelight a lesson!"

    The other three people immediately agreed.

    "Great idea!"

    "The entire outer sect dislikes him and has long wanted to deal with him!"

    "So what about the top-grade Heavenly Spiritual Root? The cultivation level is rubbish and the body is rubbish. We can't handle it!"

    The four people spoke arrogantly and unscrupulously.

    Obviously, they have long been eyeing Su Xuanchen.

    He wanted to take advantage of the unattended secret realm to bully the elderly, plunder resources, and gain fame.

    If he could suppress this "100-year-old genius" whom the sect was cultivating, he would definitely become famous in one battle when he returned to the outer sect.

    Behind the trees, a slight chill flashed across Su Xuanchen's eyes.

    I wanted to hunt for treasure safely and develop in a low-key manner.

    However, there are always people coming to look for trouble.

    In this case, don't blame him for being ruthless.

    Su Xuanchen stopped hiding and walked slowly out of the bushes.

    His white hair was blowing slightly in the wind, his body was stooped, and his breath was flat.

    He still looked like he was in his twilight years, weak and vulnerable.
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 16: Defeating the strong with the weak, seizing the treasure in a low-key manner
